line.s_my_puzzle.text: Look at my puzzle! A square of coloured pieces.

line.s_broken.text: Oh no! It fell and broke into pieces!

line.s_throw.text: It is broken. I think I have to throw it away.

line.s_not_broken.text: Nothing is broken! These pieces are meant to come apart.

line.s_how.text: How so? It is not a square any more.

line.s_tangram.text: It is a tangram! You can build a square from these pieces, and lots of pictures.

line.s_what.text: A tangram? How do you play it?

line.s_show.text: I will show you. Every piece has its own place in the picture.

line.s_two.text: Let's start with two triangles. Drag them onto the grey places.

line.s_tap_turns.text: If a piece does not fit, tap it. Then it turns.

line.s_house.text: And now a house. The square is the walls and the triangle is the roof.

line.s_solved.text: A house! My puzzle is not broken at all. It is even more fun!

line.s_to_forest.text: Let's take the tangram to the forest, by the brook.

line.b_fish.text: Let's build a little fish to swim down the brook.

line.b_fish_done.text: The fish is ready! Its tail is a triangle.

line.b_to_brook.text: Let's take it to the water!

line.c_boat.text: And now a boat with a sail. We will float it on the water.

line.c_square_again.text: Can we build the whole square again? All seven pieces!

line.c_solved.text: The whole square! The tangram is whole again, ready to play.

line.wrong_piece.text: This piece has another shape. Look at the gap.

line.wrong_big.text: That triangle is too big. Look at the gap.

line.p_intro.text: Let's play tangram! Drag the pieces, and tap to turn them when you need to.

line.p_gap.text: One piece is missing. Point to the one that fits the gap.

line.a_game.text: Let's play tangram, just like at home.

line.a_paper.text: First a square from two triangles. At home you can cut it out of paper.

line.a_ask_parents.text: Ask your parents to cut a square out of paper with you and cut it into triangles. What will you build?

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for our adventure together! Here's a sticker for your album, to remember it by. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is the block from Fox. We got it when we made pictures out of triangles.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you soon!
